comment: Music selection and the procedural bed renderer (US-16.1; D-156). 'locations' maps where the run stands to an audio/contexts.json context; a fight's encounter pool may override it ('pools'). The run end picks by outcome. A bed loop is 'notesPerLoop' notes, one per variant cadence (ms), each a scale degree within 'lift' steps above the root an octave up, walked by a seeded xorshift so a bed always renders the same samples; 'drone' adds the root under it, 'pulse' a short tick on every beat. Gains are fractions of the bed's own gain. 'sfx' maps combat event types to audio/sfx.json recipes (US-16.2): a family field appends the payload's value (procBurst_frost), the synth resolves family-then-specific, and at most maxPerCommand distinct sounds play per command.
